OUTVERTS are OUTLET adverts that
are too big to fit in OUTBOARD!!
If you send in an advert or any
message that is too big for our
OUTBOARD section then it will go
in OUTVERTS.

There is NO CHARGE to our OUTLET
readers (even if you only buy an
occasional OUTLET). Adverts stay
in OUTVERTS until 1. crowded off
by new ones (you can re-apply),
2. You ask for it to be removed.
3. We consider it finished.

OUTLET EXTRA 1 - has the first 7
OUTCLASSES(best machine code for
beginners ever!);JACKSOFT(m/code
assembler);  SINGLESTEP (run and
display code step by step);COL80
(prints OUTLET text in up to 137
chars a line);OUTPRINT (prints 3
columns);OUTSTART(disassembler);
UNITRANS+(tape file to Disciple/
Opus/Mdrive);TRANSBACK(Opus file
to tape); OUTDEX (OUTLET index).


Only `3.50 from CHEZRON SOFTWARE
34, Saltersgate Drive, Birstall,
Leicester, LE4 3FF





CLIPPER 1. This is a compilation
of clip art images on tape, +3
disc or Disciple/+D disc and
includes CLIP COMPOSER (lets you
edit images by moving areas of
the screen to other areas or to
other screens to pixel position
etc., RTCLIP to add a large text
to screens and RTCLIPAID to let
you type the large text like a
simple wordprocessor.

The clip art is a compilation of
over 50 screens, most with about
six individual images of various
kinds - PREVIOUSLY IN OUTLET,now
with a show and print program.

Only `3.50 from CHEZRON SOFTWARE
34, Saltersgate Drive, Birstall,
Leicester, LE4 3FF


CLIPPER 2 TO CLIPPER 8 are seven
discs of clipart images FORMERLY
AS SOLD BY TEACHERS PET SOFTWARE
and many of these screens will
gradually appear in OUTLET over
a long period.

They are currently available on
Disciple/+D disc most with about
70 screens each with one to six
images. If we receive sufficient
demand we shall consider making
them available on +3 discs and
possibly tape but they will need
to be in compressed format.

Each disc in the CLIPPER 2 to 8
series (state which numbers you
want with order) is `3.50 from
CHEZRON SOFTWARE 34, Saltersgate
Drive,Birstall,Leicester,LE4 3FF


CATLOADER V.2!: This is the BEST
Disciple/+D file-handler being a
much-improved version of the one
previously in OUTLET. It is very
much faster to CAT the disc and
selectively copy files, copying
files up to 30K without reset(no
limit if Betados). It includes a
text reader for quick scan and
print of text files and a screen
loader and display (with border
colour change) - all automatic -
just press the keyletter to load
BASIC, SCREEN$ or text!

All commands are with just one
or two keys so it is the FASTEST
and SIMPLEST of ANY file-handler
we've seen! One or two drives;
selected file delete;RENAME also
does case change(eg, "name.C" to
"NAME.c).

Up to the full 80 possible files
on any disc can be displayed on
two pages (toggled by the SYMBOL
key); BASIC programs are listed
first and different filetypes
are in different colours (which
you can now customise to taste).

The new CATLOADER comes with a
printed,easy-reference manual.It
is on general sale at `6.99 BUT
ONLY `3.50 TO OUTLET READERS!

A version for +3 is in OUTLET 33
(does not included RENAME or the
colour-customisation of the +D
version).
        CHEZRON SOFTWARE
     34, Saltersgate Drive,
      Birstall, Leicester,
            LE4 3FF


CATLOADER FOR PC LUNTER EMULATOR
FOR PSEUDO-MICRODRIVE OPERATION!

This is our microdrive version
of CATLOADER now available on PC
disc for directly loading into
and use by the Lunter Spectrum
Emulator in Microdrive mode. The
Lunter emulator is available
from BG SERVICES (see OUTBOARD).

This version does not include

enable you to easily load and
delete individual files with a
single keypress!

Ask for PC Emulator CATLOADER.
Only `2.00 from CHEZRON SOFTWARE

20 The Parklands, Droitwich Spa,
Worcs.WR9 7DG. Tel:01905 775840.

Emulator with PC versions.
          ROADCRAFT TEST
Based on ROADCRAFT: police driv-
ers' handbook - also used by the
Institute of Advanced Motorists
and the Advanced Drivers' Assoc-
iation of the Royal Society for
the Prevention of Accidents for
their Advanced Driving Tests.The
test is of use to all drivers.45
questions in random batches of 5
at a time. Large text and large
YES and NO answers (latter with
appropriate sound)Ideal for home
and public show - bystanders can
easily watch the proceedings and
share the learning exercise. `6

        CYCLE CODE TEST
Text/graphic test with virtually
all Highway Code's special requ-
irements for cyclists.45 questi-
ons in batches of 9, large text
and large YES+NO answers(latter
with appropriate sound). Ideal
for home and public show,bystan-
ders can easily watch progress
and share the experience. `6

          SAFE TRAVEL
Quiz & Guide,converted from Suzy
Lamplugh Trust leaflet.Education
for all on how to recognise,deal
with,avoid, dangerous situations
on foot,bicycle,car,taxi or pub-
lic transport. Choice of subject
information or random selection
5 questions from chosen subjects
for prompt user turnover at home
school, club or public events.`6

          HIGHWAY TEST
HIGHWAY TEST now available for
all motorists and L drivers for
new theory part of driving test,
with 96 random multiple choice
questions on the motoring parts
of "The Highway Code".  Crown
copyright data reproduced by
permission of The Controller of
Her Majesty's Stationery Office.
Large text, sound, illustrations
and score. For home, training &
public show use.Spectrum +D/+3 &
PC(Sam version under conversion)
Highway test includes full vers-
ion of FLEXIPAGE, text/ graphics
author with multiple use:inter-
active,free format and automatic
display for beginners to experts
to compose your own exercises.
Send SAE for full list. `6


       SAFE DRIVING VIDEO

Used successfully as a training

car drivers,this quality record-

course "Defensive Driving" using
various approaches,including the
driver's eye view of the road
during a running commentary from
a former police advanced driver.

This video can complement the PC

due to production costs.  This
one is reasonably priced at `35.

body_ru:
## OUTVERTS

OUTVERTS — это объявления из журнала OUTLET, которые оказались слишком большими для рубрики OUTBOARD! Если вы пришлете сообщение, которое не помещается в OUTBOARD, оно будет опубликовано здесь.

Для читателей OUTLET публикация БЕСПЛАТНА. Объявления остаются в разделе OUTVERTS, пока: 1. их не вытеснят новые (вы можете подать заявку повторно), 2. вы не попросите их удалить, 3. мы не сочтем их неактуальными.

### CHEZRON SOFTWARE
**OUTLET EXTRA 1** — первые 7 выпусков OUTCLASSES (лучшие уроки машинного кода для новичков!), JACKSOFT (ассемблер), SINGLESTEP (пошаговый отладчик), COL80 (печать текста OUTLET до 137 символов в строку), OUTPRINT (печать в 3 колонки), OUTSTART (дизассемблер), UNITRANS+ (копирование с ленты на Disciple/Opus/Mdrive), TRANSBACK (с Opus на ленту), OUTDEX (индекс OUTLET). 
Цена: £3.50. Адрес: CHEZRON SOFTWARE, 34, Saltersgate Drive, Birstall, Leicester, LE4 3FF.

**CLIPPER 1** — сборник клипартов на ленте, +3 диске или Disciple/+D диске. Включает CLIP COMPOSER, RTCLIP и RTCLIPAID. Более 50 экранов. Цена: £3.50.

**CLIPPER 2 — CLIPPER 8** — семь дисков с клипартами (ранее продавались TEACHERS PET SOFTWARE). На каждом около 70 экранов. Цена: £3.50 за диск.

**CATLOADER V.2!** — лучший файловый менеджер для Disciple/+D. Очень быстрый и простой. Поддерживает до 80 файлов, настраиваемые цвета. Для читателей OUTLET — £3.50 (обычная цена £6.99). Также доступен **PC EMULATOR CATLOADER** (£2.00).

### FLEXIBASE SERVICES
*20 The Parklands, Droitwich Spa, Worcs. WR9 7DG. Тел: 01905 775840.*
* ROADCRAFT TEST: Тест на основе руководства для полицейских водителей. £6.
* CYCLE CODE TEST: Правила дорожного движения для велосипедистов. £6.
* SAFE TRAVEL: Обучающий тест по безопасности. £6.
* HIGHWAY TEST: Подготовка к теории вождения. Включает FLEXIPAGE. £6.
* SAFE DRIVING VIDEO: Видеокурс по защитному вождению. £35.

### ЖУРНАЛ 8 BIT
Двухмесячный журнал для пользователей 8-битных компьютеров (CPC, SAM, C64, PCW, Spectrum). Обмен файлами, DTP, новости клубов. Цена: £1.50 за выпуск. Адрес: Brian Watson, Harrowden, 39, High Street, Sutton, ELY, Cambs, CB6 2RA.

### TOMATO GIRL SERVICES
*B. Dowsland, 26 Elsie Street, Goole, E.Yorkshire, DN14 6DU*
Буклеты по Multiface, сервисные руководства для +3, Music Writer, ремонт Spectrum. Также коллекция клипартов (более 240 экранов). Пришлите £2 или конверт с обратным адресом (SAE) для получения информации.

### SINTECH
*Gastackerstr.23 D-70794 Filderstadt, Германия / Trading Post, Viktoria Road, Shifnal, Shropshire, TF11 8AF, Великобритания*
Огромный выбор ПО для Spectrum. Игры от £4.65. Оборудование: платы +2A/+2B, дисководы, блоки питания, мембраны клавиатур и многое другое. Обращайтесь к Bernadette Dowsland за каталогом.

### ВИДЕОЦИФРОВКА
Bernadette Dowsland предлагает услуги по оцифровке видео для Spectrum. Низкие цены, форматы VHS или Beta. Поддерживаются все форматы дисков (Opus, +D, +3).
